tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The chrome: header, side panes, pane heads, tab strips and status bar. Warm ivory in light, warm charcoal in dark. Inside the work area it is repointed to surface-work.

tokens.name: surface-work
tokens.usage: The work area's ground (editor, chat, previews, panes in the centre), a step lighter than the chrome so the work reads first.

tokens.name: surface-chrome
tokens.usage: Alias of surface resolved once at the root, so a tab strip inside the work area keeps the chrome tone. Same value as surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus, toasts, inputs, table bodies and the selected tab's face. White in light.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: code blocks, technical detail, the account box, skeleton bars. No longer the side panes.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, quiet buttons and the status bar's borderless buttons.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a meter: a filled track with no edge. The figure beside the bar carries the value.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tree row and selected table row. Same value as accent-soft.

tokens.name: surface-row-selected
tokens.usage: The picked-out row in a right-pane list (Files, Checks, Changes, Running): a tonal shift of the pane, never green, with the row-current-bar.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground. No longer the primary button.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panes, rows and pane heads. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkbox, segmented control). 3:1 on surface, surface-work and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and inactive tab labels on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, comments in code and the faintest metadata. 4.5:1 on surface, surface-work, surface-raised and surface-sunken; never essential content.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal. Actions and selection: the primary button fill, the selected tab's foot bar and icon, the selected project row's bar, checked boxes, progress, the active pane-bar pill's icon.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent-filled controls.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent-filled controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for selection: the current project row, the active pane-bar pill, the StateArt backdrop.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, the selected project's name and accent-coloured text on every surface and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Violet. The coding agents' own hue: agent tab icons, the working ring, menu items that start an agent, the StateArt prompt. Never used for actions or selection.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind agent-text, such as an agent Badge.

tokens.name: agent-text
tokens.usage: Agent text: Claude's byline in a chat, an agent row's working line, the composer's options summary.

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: The Portikus mark's tile. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: brand-stone
tokens.usage: The mark's portico, on brand-tile. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-spark
tokens.usage: The mark's prompt and cursor, and the StateArt cursor. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-on-light
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour for light grounds, named so a pane with its own scheme (a light terminal) can pick it.

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour for dark grounds.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: focus-on-light or focus-on-dark by theme. 3:1 on every surface token in its theme.

tokens.name: row-current-bar
tokens.usage: A 2px inset ink bar on the start edge of the current row in the right pane's lists.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and narrow-window drawers.

tokens.name: status-provisioning
tokens.usage: Workspace is being created. Transitional, shown with motion; the info Badge tone.

tokens.name: status-provisioning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for provisioning.

tokens.name: status-starting
tokens.usage: Workspace is booting, or desired state is running while state is stopped. Also the info tone: info callouts and the pane note.

tokens.name: status-starting-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for the info tone: info Badge, info callout, pane note.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Workspace is up; the success Badge tone; a passed check.

tokens.name: status-running-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for the success tone.

tokens.name: status-stopping
tokens.usage: Workspace is shutting down. Transitional, shown with motion.

tokens.name: status-stopping-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for stopping.

tokens.name: status-stopped
tokens.usage: Workspace is off; the neutral Badge tone. Never alarming.

tokens.name: status-stopped-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for the neutral tone.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Failure: workspace error, failed check, chat error. Always paired with a sentence and an action; the danger Badge tone.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for the danger tone and the error StateArt backdrop.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: an agent that needs input, an open permission card's start border, limits near 80 percent, the disconnect countdown, Bypass permissions.

tokens.name: status-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Amber fill: the warning Badge, a needs-input agent row in the project list.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and their confirmations. Same hue as error, separate token.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill for danger.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for destructive buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: git-added
tokens.usage: Git added and untracked letters (SPEC 12.1).

tokens.name: git-modified
tokens.usage: Git modified letters.

tokens.name: git-deleted
tokens.usage: Git deleted letters.

tokens.name: git-conflict
tokens.usage: Git conflict: its own hue so a conflict never looks like an ordinary change.

tokens.name: git-conflict-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a conflict letter.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal ground. Values are keyed by the terminal's own scheme (data-terminal-theme), not the page theme.

tokens.name: terminal-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Ended-session and banner text in the terminal pane.

tokens.name: terminal-cursor
tokens.usage: Terminal cursor.

tokens.name: terminal-selection
tokens.usage: Terminal selection background.

tokens.name: terminal-line
tokens.usage: Hairline between terminal panes, on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

tokens.usage: xterm.js ANSI colour, keyed by terminal scheme. Every foreground meets 4.5:1 on its terminal-bg.

color.terminalThemes: Terminal and ansi-* tokens are keyed by data-terminal-theme on the terminal pane, which each student sets per terminal, independent of the page theme. 'light' is the light terminal, 'dark' the dark (default) one.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Page titles: one per page, and standalone pages (sign-in, session ended, not authorized).

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Pane titles, section headings and empty-state titles.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Your workspace is starting. This usually takes a few seconds.
styles.usage: Default interface text: rows, tabs, labels, buttons.

styles.name: text-compact
styles.usage: Kept as an alias of text-body; dense administrator tables still use the 13px compact density font.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels and table headers. 600 weight is for titles only.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Badges, metadata, status bar, helper text. Never below 12px.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Code inside the interface: chat code blocks, shell boxes, values. 13px.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Image versions, error codes, IDs in administrator views.

scale.note: Interface steps 12, 14, 16, 20 and 24. 13 is the code size for code set inside the interface (chat code, shell boxes, inline paths). The editor and terminal start at 14.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, badges, the status bar, pane-bar labels.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Code inside the interface, in the mono face. Also the compact density font.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Body: rows, tabs, labels, buttons, menus, navigation.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Pane titles, the project name in the header, section headings, chat prose.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog titles.

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: Page titles and standalone pages.

spacing.note: 4px base. Names match Tailwind's default spacing steps (p-3 = space-3 = 12px) when --spacing is 4px.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-dot gaps, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls; tree indent unit is space-4.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact control horizontal padding; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Comfortable control horizontal padding; pane header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and dialog inner padding at compact density; tree indent per level.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane gutters at comfortable density.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Standalone page inner padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top offset of standalone pages (sign-in).

radius.note: Mostly square. Real tools (terminal, editor, panes) take radius-none.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panes, terminals, the editor. Real tools keep square corners.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inset elements, shortcut keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, menu items, tooltips. Tabs stay square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the sign-in panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, spinners, the pane grip, the round Jump to latest button, the pane-bar pill and count pills.

shadow.note: Floating things and cards. Panes and tables are separated by lines. Dark adds a hairline because shadows vanish on dark grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Panes and tables: separated by line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards resting in the work area: the composer, chat step groups, shell boxes, check output; a dragged tab.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards that ask for attention or float: permission and question cards, the workspace starting card, menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, inputs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Comfortable buttons, inputs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Sign-in primary action; the only large control.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and compact rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state and dialog status icons.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Height of every Badge, the one status pill.

tokens.name: size-pane-handle
tokens.usage: Hit area of a resizable pane handle; the visible line is 1px.

tokens.name: size-tab-floor
tokens.usage: The narrowest a centre-pane tab gets; past this the strip scrolls.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed side-pane rail at 1024 wide.

density.note: Two density modes set on a container with data-density. Components read --pk-control, --pk-row, --pk-tree-row, --pk-tab, --pk-pad and --pk-font, which bundle.css maps from these tokens.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-control
tokens.usage: Student default: control height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-row
tokens.usage: Student default: list and menu row height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-tree-row
tokens.usage: Student default: file tree row height, tighter than a list row so a deep tree fits.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-tab
tokens.usage: Student default: tab height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-pad
tokens.usage: Student default: control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-font
tokens.usage: Student default: UI text size (text-body).

tokens.name: density-compact-control
tokens.usage: Administrator default: control height.

tokens.name: density-compact-row
tokens.usage: Administrator default: table and menu row height.

tokens.name: density-compact-tree-row
tokens.usage: Administrator default: file tree row height.

tokens.name: density-compact-tab
tokens.usage: Administrator default: tab height.

tokens.name: density-compact-pad
tokens.usage: Administrator default: control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: density-compact-font
tokens.usage: Administrator default: UI text size (text-compact).

ring.note: Focus rings: outline in the focus colour, never removed without a replacement.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: ring-offset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset for free-standing controls.

tokens.name: ring-offset-inset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset for rows, tabs and cells inside scrolling containers, so the ring is never clipped.

timing.note: Motion is functional only. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms and the spin becomes a static glyph.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and toasts entering.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One rotation of the transition indicator in StateBadge.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for entering elements.

tokens.name: z-pane-handle
tokens.usage: Resizable pane handles above pane content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and tab strips.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, tooltips, above dialogs because dialogs contain them.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast viewport, above dialogs.
